data.raw_text:
What??!! Senator @bamaquino's presentation during Manila Tech Summit had a slide that featured our news report on @bitpinas about the blockchain for government initiative of @gelowongg @heypaulroots @alfredqmbao and their team at @BayaniChain on @0xPolygon!

I remember we have something going on this day. Despite the incredible traffic on Taft Avenue, @Catch2T8  made sure to make it to Philippines Department of Budget and Management (@DBMgovph) office where the announcement was done. 

We opted to publish the post the next day because it was late if we publish it at 9pm. @Nath_Cajuday took over editing role while I talk (or text?!) to @heypaulroots  who provided us all information for @ShiBertillo_bp to be able to write a proper article since we are all thinking that putting select budget documents being put on chain is historic and something that could lead to something more important - a more transparent bureacracy. 

It was one of our biggest news stories of the year! It was also one of our most highly cited as it was the source of the story by @CriptoAZ at @Cointelegraph (tnx @leah_cb!) and other prominent publications in crypto media. Bayanichain assisted as well to make sure the story reaches @sandeepnailwal and the wider @0xPolygonEco community. 

With blockchain and crypto now having national attention, we can’t wait to continue what we continue doing at BitPinas — properly covering the crypto and blockchain industry in the Philippines for the years to come. 🫡

Thank you @gelowongg  @alfredqmbao  and Paul for snapping this photo. 

Follow @bitpinas too!
